#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
RSS feed fetch → clean → summarize → store
Creates at least 3 timestamped summary files in data/output/
"""
import os
import sys
import time
import datetime
import urllib.request
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
import re

# List of RSS feeds to process
FEEDS = [
    "http://feeds.bbci.co.uk/news/rss.xml",
    "http://rss.cnn.com/rss/cnn_topstories.rss",
    "https://feeds.reuters.com/reuters/topNews",
]

def fetch_rss(url):
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=10) as resp:
            return resp.read()
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Failed to fetch {url}: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
        return None

def parse_rss(data):
    try:
        root = ET.fromstring(data)
    except ET.ParseError as e:
        print(f"XML parse error: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
        return []
    items = []
    for item in root.findall('.//item'):
        title = item.findtext('title')
        link = item.findtext('link')
        pubDate = item.findtext('pubDate')
        description = item.findtext('description')
        items.append({'title': title, 'link': link, 'pubDate': pubDate, 'description': description})
    return items

def sanitize_filename(s):
    return re.sub(r'[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]', '_', s)

def main():
    os.makedirs('data/output', exist_ok=True)
    summaries = []
    for feed_url in FEEDS:
        data = fetch_rss(feed_url)
        if not data:
            continue
        items = parse_rss(data)
        for itm in items:
            if len(summaries) >= 3:
                break
            title = itm['title'] or 'No Title'
            link = itm['link'] or ''
            pubDate = itm['pubDate'] or ''
            description = itm['description'] or ''
            summary_text = f"Title: {title}\nLink: {link}\nPublished: {pubDate}\n\n{description}"
            summaries.append((title, summary_text))
        if len(summaries) >= 3:
            break

    timestamp = datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
    for idx, (title, text) in enumerate(summaries, 1):
        safe_title = sanitize_filename(title)[:30]
        filename = f"data/output/{timestamp}_{idx}_{safe_title}.txt"
        with open(filename, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            f.write(text)
        print(f"Saved summary to {filename}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
